geometryValidation.method: Parse each 4-value wire.line tuple as a segment. Test proposed orthogonal segments against different-net existing wires (including endpoint contact), component pins, port pins, existing foreign-net segment endpoints, and other candidate nets. Geometry is checked on the baseline only and does not replace native netlist validation.
geometryValidation.result: PASS geometry only: all three routes are orthogonal, have no foreign-net wire/pin/port/endpoint intersections, and no cross-route foreign-net intersections; nearest foreign geometry is 10 units.
